```{r}
draw_network_weights <- function() {
  op <- par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0)); on.exit(par(op))
  plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 680), ylim = c(550, 0), asp = 1,
       axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")

  col_f <- "#9FE1CB"; col_g <- "#FAC775"; col_y <- "#F5C4B3"
  line_col <- adjustcolor("gray40", 0.5)

  xin <- 50; xh <- c(170, 290, 410); xo <- 520; xy <- 632
  yF  <- c(65, 110, 175); yG <- c(325, 370, 435); yin <- c(65, 120, 175)

  conn <- function(x1, ys1, x2, ys2, r1, r2)
    for (a in ys1) for (b in ys2)
      segments(x1 + r1, a, x2 - r2, b, col = line_col, lwd = 0.7)
  node <- function(x, y, r, bg)
    symbols(x, y, circles = rep(r, length(x)), inches = FALSE,
            add = TRUE, bg = bg, fg = "gray30")
  wlabel <- function(x, y, W, b, cnt) {
    text(x, y,      W,   font = 2, cex = 0.75)
    text(x, y + 16, b,              cex = 0.75)
    text(x, y + 32, cnt,            cex = 0.75)
  }

  # ---- connections ----
  conn(xin,   yin, xh[1], yF, 13, 12)
  conn(xh[1], yF,  xh[2], yF, 12, 12)
  conn(xh[2], yF,  xh[3], yF, 12, 12)
  conn(xh[3], yF,  xo,    120, 12, 16)

  conn(xin,   380, xh[1], yG, 13, 12)      # time branch: one hidden layer
  conn(xh[1], yG,  xo,    380, 12, 16)

  segments(xo + 16, 120, xy - 16, 242, col = line_col, lwd = 0.7)
  segments(xo + 16, 380, xy - 16, 258, col = line_col, lwd = 0.7)

  # ---- nodes ----
  node(rep(xin, 3), yin, 13, col_f)
  text(xin, yin, c("x1", "x2", "x3"), font = 2, cex = 0.8)
  node(xin, 380, 13, col_g); text(xin, 380, "t", font = 2, cex = 0.8)

  for (k in 1:3) {
    node(rep(xh[k], 3), yF, 12, col_f)
    points(rep(xh[k], 3), c(133, 142, 151), pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = "gray50")
  }
  node(rep(xh[1], 3), yG, 12, col_g)
  points(rep(xh[1], 3), c(393, 402, 411), pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = "gray50")

  node(xo, 120, 16, col_f); text(xo, 120, expression(hat(f)), cex = 0.9)
  node(xo, 380, 16, col_g); text(xo, 380, expression(hat(g)), cex = 0.9)
  node(xy, 250, 16, col_y); text(xy, 250, expression(hat(y)), cex = 0.9)

  # ---- covariate branch ----
  text(340, 20, "Covariate branch f(x1, x2, x3): 801 parameters", font = 2, cex = 0.8)
  text(c(xin, xh, xo), 44,
       c("Inputs", "Hidden 1: 32", "Hidden 2: 16", "Hidden 3: 8", "Output"), cex = 0.7)
  wlabel(110, 212, "Wf1: 3x32",  "bf1: 32", "128 params")
  wlabel(230, 212, "Wf2: 32x16", "bf2: 16", "528 params")
  wlabel(350, 212, "Wf3: 16x8",  "bf3: 8",  "136 params")
  wlabel(463, 212, "Wf4: 8x1",   "bf4: 1",  "9 params")

  # ---- time branch ----
  text(340, 280, "Time branch g(t): 61 parameters", font = 2, cex = 0.8)
  text(c(xin, xh[1], xo), 304, c("Input", "Hidden: 20", "Output"), cex = 0.7)
  text(xh[1], 455, cex = 0.7)
  wlabel(110, 472, "Wg1: 1x20", "bg1: 20", "40 params")
  wlabel(345, 472, "Wg2: 20x1", "bg2: 1",  "21 params")

  text(340, 535,
       expression(hat(y) == hat(g)(t) + hat(f)(x) ~ ":  801 + 61 = 862 parameters"),
       cex = 0.75)
}

draw_network_weights()
```

```{r}
# Reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Number of observations
n <- 1000

# Time
t <- (1:n)/n

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Changepoints
# ------------------------------------------------------------

tau1 <- 250
tau2 <- 500
tau3 <- 750

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters for g(t)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

alpha <- 10
beta0 <- 0
beta1 <- -0.1
beta2 <- 0.2
beta3 <- -0.15

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Segmented temporal function g(t)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

g <- alpha +
     beta0 * n * t +
     beta1 * n * pmax(t - tau1/n, 0) +
     beta2 * n * pmax(t - tau2/n, 0) +
     beta3 * n * pmax(t - tau3/n, 0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Covariates
# ------------------------------------------------------------

x1 <- runif(n, 0, 1)
x2 <- runif(n, 0, 1)
x3 <- runif(n, 0, 1)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Nonlinear covariate effect f(x1,x2,x3)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Rastrigin nonlinear function
f1 <- 0.05*(30 +
     (x1^2 - 10 * cos(2 * pi * x1)) +
     (x2^2 - 10 * cos(2 * pi * x2)) +
     (x3^2 - 10 * cos(2 * pi * x3)))

f <- 10*(f1-1.5)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Random error
# ------------------------------------------------------------

epsilon <- rnorm(n,mean = 0,sd = 1)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Full response
# y_t = g(t) + f(x1,x2,x3) + epsilon_t
# ------------------------------------------------------------

y <- g + f + epsilon
```

```{r}
library(keras3)

# Standardize the response
y_mean <- mean(y)
y_sd   <- sd(y)
Y <- matrix((y - y_mean) / y_sd, ncol = 1)

# Inputs for the two branches
X_cov  <- cbind(x1, x2, x3)          # already in [0, 1]
X_time <- matrix(t, ncol = 1)        # already in (0, 1]
```

```{r}
lambda         <- 0.0001    # lasso tuning parameter
dropout_rate   <- 0.05     # dropout for the f branch
dropout_rate_g <- 0     # dropout for the g branch (was 0.40, too heavy for 10 neurons)
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
keras3::set_random_seed(123)

input_x <- layer_input(shape = 3, name = "covariates")   # x1, x2, x3
input_t <- layer_input(shape = 1, name = "time")         # t

# ---- Branch for f(x1, x2, x3): unchanged ----
branch_f <- input_x |>
  layer_dense(units = 32, activation = "relu") |>
  layer_dropout(rate = dropout_rate) |>
  layer_dense(units = 16, activation = "relu") |>
  layer_dropout(rate = dropout_rate) |>
  layer_dense(units = 8,  activation = "relu") |>
  layer_dense(units = 1,  activation = "linear")

# ---- Branch for g(t): 1 hidden layer, 10 neurons, kinks spread over (0, 1) ----
branch_g <- input_t |>
  layer_dense(units = 20, activation = "relu",
              kernel_initializer = initializer_random_uniform(minval = 1,  maxval = 2),
              bias_initializer   = initializer_random_uniform(minval = -1, maxval = 0)) |>
  layer_dropout(rate = dropout_rate_g) |>
  layer_dense(units = 1, activation = "linear")

output <- layer_add(list(branch_g, branch_f))
model  <- keras_model(inputs = list(input_x, input_t), outputs = output)
```

```{r}
# p = total number of parameters (weights + biases)
p <- count_params(model)

lasso_loss <- function(y_true, y_pred) {
  # (1/n) * sum (y - y_hat)^2
  mse_part <- op_mean(op_square(y_true - y_pred))

  # sum |theta_j| over every weight and bias
  abs_sum <- Reduce(`+`, lapply(model$trainable_variables,
                                function(w) op_sum(op_abs(w))))

  # MSE + lambda * (1/p) * sum |theta_j|
  mse_part + lambda * abs_sum / p
}
```

```{r}
model |> compile(
  optimizer = optimizer_adam(learning_rate = 0.01),
  loss = lasso_loss,
  metrics = list("mean_squared_error")    # plain MSE reported separately
)
```


```{r}
set.seed(123)
history <- model |> fit(
  x = list(X_cov, X_time),
  y = Y,
  epochs = 500,
  batch_size = 32,
  validation_split = 0,
  verbose = 1
)
```

```{r}
# These share the trained weights with `model`, so nothing is retrained
model_f <- keras_model(inputs = input_x, outputs = branch_f)   # f(x1, x2, x3) branch
model_g <- keras_model(inputs = input_t, outputs = branch_g)   # g(t) branch
```


```{r}
wf <- get_weights(model_f)
wg <- get_weights(model_g)

# ---- Covariate branch f(x1, x2, x3): unchanged ----
Wf1 <- wf[[1]]; bf1 <- wf[[2]]     # 3 x 32 ; 32
Wf2 <- wf[[3]]; bf2 <- wf[[4]]     # 32 x 16 ; 16
Wf3 <- wf[[5]]; bf3 <- wf[[6]]     # 16 x 8 ; 8
Wf4 <- wf[[7]]; bf4 <- wf[[8]]     # 8 x 1 ; 1

# ---- Time branch g(t): one hidden layer ----
Wg1 <- wg[[1]]; bg1 <- wg[[2]]     # 1 x 10 ; 10
Wg2 <- wg[[3]]; bg2 <- wg[[4]]     # 10 x 1 ; 1
```

```{r}
relu <- function(z) pmax(z, 0)
add_bias <- function(M, b) M + matrix(as.vector(b), nrow(M), length(b), byrow = TRUE)

a1 <- relu(add_bias(X_time %*% Wg1, bg1))
g_hat_manual <- as.vector(a1 %*% Wg2 + bg2[1])

g_hat_keras <- as.vector(predict(model_g, X_time, verbose = 0))

max(abs(g_hat_manual - g_hat_keras))     # should be about 0
```
```{r}
set.seed(123)
tg   <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 1000)       # fine grid in the original t
tg_s <- tg                                  # the model sees t directly, so no transformation
G    <- length(tg)

rep_b <- function(b, G) matrix(as.vector(b), nrow = G, ncol = length(b), byrow = TRUE)   # repeats a bias vector down the rows of a matrix
```

```{r}
# Layer 1: the only hidden layer
pre1 <- outer(tg_s, as.vector(Wg1)) + rep_b(bg1, G)       # G x 10, input before the ReLU
a1   <- pmax(pre1, 0)                                      # output after the ReLU
d1   <- (pre1 > 0) * matrix(as.vector(Wg1), G, 20, byrow = TRUE)   # slope of each neuron

# Output of the branch and its exact slope
g_curve <- as.vector(a1 %*% Wg2 + bg2[1])
slope   <- as.vector(d1 %*% Wg2) * y_sd      # * y_sd puts the slope on the scale of y
```

```{r}
h  <- 0.04                               # The window width in time
k  <- round(h / (tg[2] - tg[1]))         # The number of grid points that fit in the window
cs <- c(0, cumsum(slope))

i      <- k:(G - k)
after  <- (cs[i + k + 1] - cs[i + 1]) / k          # mean slope just after t
before <- (cs[i + 1] - cs[i - k + 1]) / k          # mean slope just before t
score  <- after - before                           # estimated slope change at t
t_i    <- tg[i]
```

```{r}
score_tbl <- data.frame(t = t_i, score = score)

View(score_tbl)
```

```{r}
  jump_true = c(beta1, beta2, beta3) * n         # -100, +200, -150
)
```

```{r}
pick <- function(score, t_i, m = 3, min_gap = 0.15) {
  s <- abs(score); chosen <- c()
  for (j in 1:m) {
    idx    <- which.max(s)
    chosen <- c(chosen, idx)
    s[abs(t_i - t_i[idx]) < min_gap] <- -Inf
  }
  sort(chosen)
}

sel  <- pick(score, t_i)
est2 <- data.frame(tau_hat      = t_i[sel],
                   slope_change = score[sel],
                   index        = round(t_i[sel] * n))

cbind(truth, est2)
```

```{r}
pick_all <- function(score, t_i, m = 10, min_gap = 2*h) {
  s <- abs(score); chosen <- c()
  for (j in 1:m) {
    if (max(s) <= 0) break                      # nothing left (flat or fully blocked out)
    idx    <- which.max(s)
    chosen <- c(chosen, idx)
    s[abs(t_i - t_i[idx]) < min_gap] <- -Inf    # block out this peak's neighborhood
  }
  chosen                                        # biggest peak first
}

cand <- pick_all(score, t_i)

data.frame(rank  = seq_along(cand),
           tau   = round(t_i[cand], 7),
           score = round(score[cand], 2))
```

```{r}
f_hat <- as.vector(predict(model_f, X_cov,  verbose = 0)) * y_sd
g_hat <- as.vector(predict(model_g, X_time, verbose = 0)) * y_sd

# The two branches can trade a constant, so match each to the level of the truth
f_hat <- f_hat - mean(f_hat) + mean(f)
g_hat <- g_hat - mean(g_hat) + mean(g)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
library(changepoint)
library(segmented)
library(strucchange)
library(genlasso)
library(not)
```


```{r}
y_trend <- g + epsilon                     # y with the covariate effect removed, used by every method
truth_t <- c(tau1, tau2, tau3) / n         # 0.25, 0.50, 0.75

merge_close <- function(idx, gap = 5) {    # merges neighboring indices into one location
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(idx)
  grp <- cumsum(c(1, diff(idx) > gap))
  as.integer(round(tapply(idx, grp, mean)))
}
```

```{r}
cp_mine <- est2$tau_hat                    # your method, number of changepoints given (m = 3)

cand <- pick_all(score, t_i)               # candidate peaks, biggest first
bic  <- sapply(0:length(cand), function(k) {
  if (k == 0) {
    fit <- lm(y_trend ~ t)
  } else {
    H   <- sapply(t_i[cand[1:k]], function(c0) pmax(t - c0, 0))
    fit <- lm(y_trend ~ t + H)
  }
  n * log(sum(residuals(fit)^2) / n) + (2 * k + 2) * log(n)
})
k_hat       <- which.min(bic) - 1
cp_mine_bic <- sort(t_i[cand[seq_len(k_hat)]])     # your method, number chosen by BIC

cp_mine; cp_mine_bic
```

# Segmented regression: Estimates breakpoints in a piecewise-linear trend directly, and selgmented() chooses the number by BIC
```{r}
fit0 <- lm(y_trend ~ t)
sel_seg <- selgmented(fit0, seg.Z = ~t, Kmax = 6, type = "bic", msg = FALSE)

cp_segmented <- if (inherits(sel_seg, "segmented")) sort(sel_seg$psi[, "Est."]) else numeric(0)
cp_segmented
```

```{r}
fit0 <- lm(y ~ t)
sel_seg <- selgmented(fit0, seg.Z = ~t, Kmax = 6, type = "bic", msg = FALSE)

cp_segmented <- if (inherits(sel_seg, "segmented")) sort(sel_seg$psi[, "Est."]) else numeric(0)
cp_segmented
```


# Bai-Perron structural breaks: It fits a separate line in each segment, so it handles slope changes
```{r}
bp     <- breakpoints(y_trend ~ t, h = 0.1)
bp_opt <- breakpoints(bp)                  # number of breaks chosen by BIC

cp_bp <- if (all(is.na(bp_opt$breakpoints))) numeric(0) else t[bp_opt$breakpoints]
cp_bp
```

# L1 trend filtering: Fits a piecewise-linear curve with a lasso penalty on the second differences, so its kinks are the changepoints.
```{r}
tf   <- trendfilter(y_trend, ord = 1)
cvtf <- cv.trendfilter(tf)
fit_tf <- as.vector(coef(tf, lambda = cvtf$lambda.1se)$beta)

d2    <- abs(diff(fit_tf, differences = 2))
kinks <- which(d2 > 1e-4 * max(d2)) + 1
cp_tf <- t[merge_close(kinks)]
cp_tf
```

```{r}
cp_tf
```

# Narrowest-Over-Threshold: Designed for piecewise-linear signals and finds the number without being told it.
```{r}
set.seed(123)
w      <- not(y_trend, contrast = "pcwsLinContMean")
cp_not <- t[features(w)$cpt]
cp_not
```

# PELT: It finds changes in the mean
```{r}
B   <- 20
nb  <- n %/% B
blk <- rep(1:nb, each = B)

bs <- sapply(1:nb, function(b) {
  i <- which(blk == b)
  unname(coef(lm(y_trend[i] ~ t[i]))[2])
})

sig     <- mad(diff(bs)) / sqrt(2)
pelt    <- cpt.mean(bs / sig, method = "PELT", penalty = "MBIC")
cp_pelt <- t[cpts(pelt) * B]
cp_pelt
```

```{r}
res <- list(
```

```{r}
par(mar = c(5, 12, 4, 2))
K <- length(res)

plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0.5, K + 0.5), yaxt = "n",
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "", main = "Estimated Changepoints by Method")
axis(2, at = K:1, labels = names(res), las = 1)
abline(v = truth_t, col = "darkgreen", lty = 3, lwd = 2)

for (j in seq_along(res)) {
  est <- res[[j]]
  if (length(est) > 0) {
    points(est, rep(K - j + 1, length(est)), pch = 19, cex = 1.5,
           col = if (j <= 2) "firebrick" else "blue")
    text(est, K - j + 1, sprintf("%.3f", est), pos = 3, cex = 0.7)
  }
}
legend("bottomright", legend = c("True changepoint", "Mine", "Other methods"),
       col = c("darkgreen", "firebrick", "blue"), lty = c(3, NA, NA),
       pch = c(NA, 19, 19), lwd = c(2, NA, NA), cex = 0.8, bty = "n")
par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))
```
